descriptor.description: create a trade order that is executed as a TWAP order over a specified duration.
descriptor.name: createTwapOrder

params_doc.amount: how much of currency you want to trade in units of base currency
params_doc.duration: the duration of the TWAP order in milliseconds
params_doc.params: extra parameters specific to the exchange API endpoint
params_doc.params.expiresAfter: time in ms after which the twap order expires
params_doc.params.randomize: whether to randomize the time intervals of the TWAP order slices (default is false, meaning equal intervals)
params_doc.params.reduceOnly: true or false whether the order is reduce-only
params_doc.symbol: unified symbol of the market to create an order in

descriptor.description: query for balance and get the amount of funds available for trading or funds locked in orders
descriptor.name: fetchBalance

params_doc.params: extra parameters specific to the exchange API endpoint
params_doc.params.dex: for hip3 markets, the dex name, eg: 'xyz'
params_doc.params.enableUnifiedMargin: enable unified margin, CCXT tries to auto-detects this value but you can override it
params_doc.params.marginMode: 'cross' or 'isolated', for margin trading, uses this.options.defaultMarginMode if not passed, defaults to undefined/None/null
params_doc.params.user: user address, will default to this.walletAddress if not provided
